kpis.title: Gross collected
kpis.definition: Income credited by paid invoices and bookings in the month, before refunds, disputes and fees (cash basis: booked when the payment is).

kpis.title: Gross collected by kind
kpis.definition: Gross collected, split by the income account's kind: membership, add-on or booking.

kpis.title: Membership revenue by tier
kpis.definition: Gross collected on membership tiers, split by tier id. A yearly payment lands whole in the month it is paid.

kpis.title: Refunds
kpis.definition: Money handed back by refunds booked in the month.

kpis.title: Disputes lost
kpis.definition: The disputes expense booked in the month: the amount a dispute withdrew, less what a won dispute gave back.

kpis.title: Dispute fees
kpis.definition: Stripe's dispute fees booked in the month.

kpis.title: Stripe fees
kpis.definition: Stripe's fees on payments the caller passed a fee for.

kpis.title: Net income
kpis.definition: Gross collected less refunds, disputes lost, dispute fees and Stripe fees (the books are cash basis, so this is also the net cash of the month).

kpis.title: Payouts
kpis.definition: Money moved to the payout clearing account in the month.

kpis.title: Payments
kpis.definition: Paid invoices and bookings booked in the month.

kpis.title: Refunds issued
kpis.definition: Refund lines booked in the month.

kpis.title: Disputes opened
kpis.definition: Disputes that withdrew money in the month.

kpis.title: Refund rate
kpis.definition: Refunds / gross collected, in the month; 0 when nothing was collected.

kpis.title: Dispute rate
kpis.definition: Disputes opened / payments, in the month; 0 when there were no payments.

kpis.title: Paying members
kpis.definition: Distinct holders with a membership payment booked in the month. A yearly member counts in the month it is paid only (the books hold no coverage period), and a member on a zero invoice is not counted: a renewal that moves no money and no credit leaves no ledger event.

kpis.title: New paying members
kpis.definition: Holders whose first membership payment is in this month.

kpis.title: Gross collected per paying member
kpis.definition: Gross collected / paying members, in the month (cents, two decimals); 0 when there were no paying members.

kpis.title: Credits granted
kpis.definition: Credit units issued to balances in the month by a plan or a gift. A renewal that resets a balance to its allowance without raising it issues nothing, so this is top-ups, not allowances.

kpis.title: Credits consumed
kpis.definition: Credit units spent (finalized bookings) in the month, net of credits given back.

kpis.title: Credits expired
kpis.definition: Credit units that lapsed unused in the month (breakage).

kpis.title: Breakage rate
kpis.definition: Credits expired / credits granted, in the month; 0 when none were granted.

kpis.title: Closing balance, USD accounts
kpis.definition: Each USD account's balance at the end of the month (every posting to date). Debits are positive, so income is negative.

kpis.title: Closing balance, credit accounts
kpis.definition: Each credit account's balance at the end of the month (every posting to date), in credit units.

kpis.title: Credits outstanding
kpis.definition: Credit units the school owes at the end of the month: everything available or held, all features and all holders, every posting to date. One school-wide total, never split by holder or account.

kpis.title: Monthly recurring revenue
kpis.definition: What the subscriptions running at the end of the month bill a month: each recurring price's amount less its discount, over the months of its interval (a yearly price is a twelfth), rounded half up per item, in cents. One-time lines add nothing, a free (100%-discounted) subscription adds 0, a change counts from the moment Stripe makes it and a cancelled subscription leaves at its end. USD only: a subscription in another currency is never booked (its invoices leave money.skipped markers).

kpis.title: New MRR
kpis.definition: MRR added in the month by subscriptions that started (or started paying, after a free spell).

kpis.title: Expansion MRR
kpis.definition: MRR added in the month by running subscriptions that went up: more seats, a higher tier, a recurring add-on.

kpis.title: Contraction MRR
kpis.definition: MRR lost in the month by running subscriptions that went down: fewer seats, a lower tier, a discount.

kpis.title: Churned MRR
kpis.definition: MRR lost in the month by subscriptions that ended: what they billed a month before they ended.

kpis.title: Net new MRR
kpis.definition: New plus expansion less contraction and churned MRR, in the month: how much MRR moved.
